```yaml
name: Backend Required – Docs Speech Hygiene Clean

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'

jobs:
  speech-hygiene:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Detect changed documentation files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v46
        id: changed
        with:
          separator: "\n"
          files: docs/**

      - name: Run Codex to clean speech hygiene
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        uses: openai/codex-action@v1
        with:
          prompt: |
            Clean speech hygiene in the following documentation files:
            ${{ steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files }}
            Return the cleaned content for each file in the same format as the input.
          working-directory: .
          openai-api-key: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          model: gpt-4o
          effort: 2
          output-file: docs/_codex_cleaned.txt
        env:
          CODEX_HOME: /tmp/codex

      - name: Apply cleaned content
        if: steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_and_modified_files != ''
        run: |
          # Read the cleaned output
          cleaned=$(cat docs/_codex_cleaned.txt)
          # Replace original files with cleaned content
          echo "$cleaned" > docs/_cleaned_output.txt
          # (Custom logic to map cleaned content back to original files can be added here)
          # For demonstration, we simply commit the cleaned output file
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add docs/_cleaned_output.txt
          git commit -m "docs: clean speech hygiene via Codex"
          git push
```
